usage: enterobacter-classifier analyze [-h] --query QUERY --reference-package
                                       REFERENCE_PACKAGE
                                       --expected-package-sha256
                                       EXPECTED_PACKAGE_SHA256 --output OUTPUT
                                       [--threads THREADS]
                                       [--development-guides DEVELOPMENT_GUIDES]
                                       [--quality-evidence QUALITY_EVIDENCE]
                                       [--expected-quality-sha256 EXPECTED_QUALITY_SHA256]
                                       [--experimental-rank-rule EXPERIMENTAL_RANK_RULE]
                                       [--checkm2-config CHECKM2_CONFIG]
                                       [--expected-checkm2-config-sha256 EXPECTED_CHECKM2_CONFIG_SHA256]
                                       [--experimental-genomovars]
                                       [--mlst-config MLST_CONFIG]
                                       [--expected-mlst-config-sha256 EXPECTED_MLST_CONFIG_SHA256]
                                       [--experimental-eligibility-config EXPERIMENTAL_ELIGIBILITY_CONFIG]
                                       [--expected-eligibility-config-sha256 EXPECTED_ELIGIBILITY_CONFIG_SHA256]
                                       [--skani-binary SKANI_BINARY]

Run the unified development assembly workflow; no positive policy is enabled.
One command validates an assembly, runs the package-pinned skani binary,
retains raw evidence and produces the existing uncertainty report. Structural
validity does not establish biological quality. Reads and final assignment
rules are not implemented. Original assembly records are neither selected nor
discarded.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --query QUERY
  --reference-package REFERENCE_PACKAGE
  --expected-package-sha256 EXPECTED_PACKAGE_SHA256
  --output OUTPUT
  --threads THREADS
  --development-guides DEVELOPMENT_GUIDES
                        Explicit display annotations; never assignment gates
  --quality-evidence QUALITY_EVIDENCE
                        One pinned local CheckM2 evidence JSON object; imports
                        estimates without applying a QC gate
  --expected-quality-sha256 EXPECTED_QUALITY_SHA256
                        Required with --quality-evidence
  --experimental-rank-rule EXPERIMENTAL_RANK_RULE
                        Explicit disabled development rule; candidate
                        hierarchy only, never positive assignments
  --checkm2-config CHECKM2_CONFIG
                        Pinned configuration to run CheckM2 within this
                        analysis; no QC gate is implied
  --expected-checkm2-config-sha256 EXPECTED_CHECKM2_CONFIG_SHA256
                        Required with --checkm2-config
  --experimental-genomovars
                        Investigate frozen all-member compatibility when the
                        experimental rank result nominates a represented
                        target subspecies
  --mlst-config MLST_CONFIG
                        Pinned historical MLST package/runtime configuration;
                        supplementary typing only
  --expected-mlst-config-sha256 EXPECTED_MLST_CONFIG_SHA256
                        Required with --mlst-config
  --experimental-eligibility-config EXPERIMENTAL_ELIGIBILITY_CONFIG
                        Pinned disabled eligibility configuration (frozen
                        candidate policy) bound to --experimental-rank-rule;
                        needs no QC estimate; reports hypothetical eligibility
                        and any near-boundary note separately, never
                        assignments
  --expected-eligibility-config-sha256 EXPECTED_ELIGIBILITY_CONFIG_SHA256
                        Required with --experimental-eligibility-config
  --skani-binary SKANI_BINARY
                        Explicit local executable matching the package pin;
                        required for a relocated package
